target.statement: Exact recovery proportion (fraction of 100 repetitions with zero misclassification on both row and column communities) for SCDD under ScBM at K=4, ny=800, nz=1200, rho=0.3 (Experiment 1, ScBM panel, SCDD curve)
target.dataset: Synthetic ScBM bipartite graphs generated per Section 4.1 (B with diag 0.9, upper 0.2, lower 0.1; balanced communities)

compute.basis: Synthetic data only; algorithm is a 800x1200 Gram matrix eigendecomposition plus k-means, repeated 100 times per K value, all trivially CPU-bound; main cost is writing the generator and spectral code from scratch since no code is released.

blockers: No code or repository linked in the paper; algorithms (SCDD/NSCDD) and data generator must be re-implemented from the text
Baseline curves (DI-SIM, D-SCORE, BiSC, nBiSC) would need separate re-implementations if the full figure is desired
title: Exact Community Recovery in Bipartite Networks
